agent_notes: The official site is verified and identifies the Indore campus/address in Madhya Pradesh.
The academic, degree/diploma, long-duration certificate, long-duration online, asynchronous, international, GCC, and defence catalogues expose named programmes and were enumerated.

The short-duration section links to a 2026-27 MDP calendar but does not provide an itemized current certificate-programme list in the catalogue page; dated short programmes verified on the site were expired and excluded. This catalogue gap requires manual review.
Career mappings were derived from read-only queries against assets/data/career_path.db; the database was not edited.
Normal TLS failed with the managed proxy's exact self-signed-certificate-chain error; public GET requests were then retried with curl --insecure only against the expected official/search hosts.
